name: Callie
backstory: Harper Callie is a cheerful but vicious Harper at Last Light Inn during Act Two. She reports directly to Jaheira, relaying information from Quartermaster Talli to her.
voice_hint: dwarf fighter (voiced by Lucy Paterson,Luisa Guerreiro)
